svg.title: 4 KB LUT6 Bootstrap Nucleus, Wobble Harmonics, DiffLUT-Net Means Test, and Nov 2026 Looped Models
svg.desc: Data-driven summary of Phase 30: #![no_std] Rust 1.100.0 lut6-core physical DC shunt measured_j on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor and live DWT cycles on Alif Ensemble E3 (OpenMV-AE3 Cortex-M55); 64-codon biological Operon ABI with 2-bit wobble Walsh-Hadamard high-harmonic vanishing proved across 36 theorems in 6 Lean 4.36.0 kernels; closed-form multilinear DiffLUT-Net 64.06% LUT6 gate pruning and Dual-Reality evaluation; and October-November 2026 open-weight looped/hybrid models (Inkling-2-Mini, Nemotron-Labs-Dory1.0-4B, LFM2.5-24B-A2B, Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B) under uint64 LUT6 burst speculation and Rung-6 compilation.
